claim_boundary: decision-only re-scoring of retained engine-verdicted executions and the frozen #77 N1 checkpoints; stage d reads post-launch frames and is a diagnostic, not a decision-time ranker; development/exposed N1 members only (held-out = not fit by #77 predictors or controllers, still exposed through earlier tickets); no engine access, rendering or retraining; inventories and cohorts are never pooled; every interval is DESCRIPTIVE

cost_rules.start_carrier: a and b: the engine-projected position-0 carrier; ap, c and d: the parsed position-0 carrier
cost_rules.tie_rule: argmin cost, ties to the lower ordinal (top-1)
cost_rules.typed_failures: a nonfinite endpoint carrier is a retained typed failure (excluded, inherits no verdict), never retried

costs.count: frozen TaskObjective: 1000 * clamp(pig presence, 0, 1) + sum over block slots of clamp(block presence, 0, 1)
costs.tie_free: pig presence (unclamped) - 0.1 * Euclidean displacement of the pig slot center (normalized screen units) between the stage's start carrier (position 0) and the endpoint carrier; lower is better

decision_rule.Q1_attribution: supported iff guards pass AND the dominant drop's lower bound > 0; not_supported_by_this_experiment iff guards pass AND the dominant drop's upper bound < 0.02; otherwise readiness_or_precision_insufficient
decision_rule.Q2_tie_free_cost: supported iff guards pass AND at stage c on mixed grid cells (cohort all) every request's tied-cell share under the tie-free cost is < 0.1; not_supported_by_this_experiment iff guards pass and some request is >= 0.1; otherwise readiness_or_precision_insufficient
decision_rule.baseline_target: reported, not a token: any request at stage c, held-out grid, tie-free cost with AUC >= 0.65 and lower bound > 0.55; the issue's target token is decided after step 3

disclosure: Known before freeze and not re-derived here: the #96 stage-c count-cost AUCs of every request (published), the #109 held-out re-score of the same records, and the #85 finding that the parsed-endpoint count cost disagrees with engine truth in closed loop (offset 600, 42/47 proxy-only successes). No stage a/ap/b/d statistic and no tie-free statistic was computed before freeze; the smoke joins no verdict.

estimands.attribution: paired per cell, member-clustered: endpoint_perception = a - ap; one_step_dynamics(r) = ap - d(r); compounding(r) = d(r) - c(r); anchor_perception(r) = b(r) - c(r); total(r) = a - c(r); request-mean versions average the 14 requests within a cell first
estimands.cell_auc: within-cell P(successful candidate has lower cost than failed candidate), ties 0.5, over admissible candidates (verdict AND finite cost) (run_launch_power_probe.cell_auc)
estimands.compute_accounting: per request x stage: records, candidates, transition calls, controller calls, linear MACs, GPU seconds, active parameters; per record wall seconds; evidence extraction parse calls and wall seconds
estimands.interval: member-clustered percentile bootstrap, 10000 draws, PCG64 seed 7201, quantiles [0.025, 0.975], DESCRIPTIVE
estimands.perception_fidelity: outcome-free, per cohort: parser presence (>= 0.5) against engine presence per slot kind at positions 0 and 225 over every verdict-bearing shot; accuracy and mean absolute presence error
estimands.stage_auc: per cohort x inventory x cost x stage x request: member-clustered percentile bootstrap of the cell AUCs over mixed cells
estimands.ties: tied cell = every admissible cost of the cell equal (the #96 G4 definition); tied pair share = success/failure pairs with equal cost over all such pairs
estimands.top1: argmin-cost candidate succeeds; pooled count over cells with chance reported

gate_a.dominant: argmax of the three point drops; ties in the order dynamics, perception, cost

fix.cost: redefine the decision cost before any model work
fix.dynamics: retrain the predictor with a decision-aware auxiliary loss (pairwise ranking of candidate endpoints on fit lineages)

gate_a.held_out: the same drops on the held-out cohort are reported, not used for the choice
gate_a.scope: grid, cohort all, cost tie_free, request-mean

guards.G1: stage-c count cost reproduces every #96 record of the 14 requests within 0.001 (same nonfinite exclusions)
guards.G2: every executed shot's position-0 agent frame is byte-identical to the member's sealed anchor
guards.G3: engine-projected position-0 carriers agree across a member's shots within 1e-06
guards.G4: verdict resolution 1.0 and nonfinite typed-failure share <= 0.1 on mixed grid cells for every stage and request
guards.caps: run GPU seconds <= 10800.0, run wall seconds <= 21600.0
guards.failure: any guard failure -> readiness_or_precision_insufficient for Q1 and Q2

held_identical.engine_anchor: the engine-projected position-0 carrier of the member's first verdict-bearing executed shot in frozen order (inventory, ordinal); every other shot of the member must agree within 1e-06

prohibited: tuning the tie-free cost weight after any verdict join
adding stages, requests or cohorts after scoring
question: where along engine state -> perception -> carrier -> predictor rollout -> cost is the launch-ranking signal lost on the four engine-verdicted #96 inventories, and does a tie-free cost read from the same endpoint carrier remove the count cost's ties?

smoke_evidence.reading: infrastructure assertions only; no verdict was joined and no AUC, tie or top-1 statistic was computed

stages.a: engine endpoint: engine state of the executed shot at position 225 (fixed step 41250, terminal absorption) projected into the carrier (presence = active entity with a body, centers through the frame's world_to_observation transform, kinds one-hot of the declared slot kind; prior position 224 for motion) -> cost
stages.ap: perceived endpoint: the executed shot's agent frame at position 225 (prior 224; terminal absorption) parsed by the frozen issue-70 slot parser -> cost
stages.b: engine anchor: the engine state at position 0 of the member's executed shots projected into the carrier -> request rollout to 225 -> cost
stages.c: current: the member's sealed parsed anchor carrier -> request rollout to 225 -> cost (the #96 arm, recomputed)
stages.d: teacher-forced predictor: the request's pair schedule walks the executed shot's parsed carriers (fixed pair Delta: input at position 225 - Delta; J / C-J: the controller chooses on the parsed carrier at each visited position); only the final step to 225 is predicted -> cost

universe.cohort_rule: held_out = #96 members outside issue-77-n1-dynamics-v1 n1_lineages predictor and controller pools; all = every #96 member; reported side by side, never pooled

inventories.angle: #87 N1 radius-80 launch-angle sweep of the member's canonical state (9-13 candidates; #87+#89 union verdict table)
inventories.grid: #93 Arm B 4x4 Cartesian drag grid (16 candidates; #93 oracle verdicts)
inventories.offset: #93 Arm A offset angle sweep at radius 80 px (11 candidates; #93 oracle verdicts)
inventories.power: #94 angle x launch-power sweep (20 candidates; #94 oracle verdicts; out of training support per #95, secondary only)

universe.mixed_rule: a (inventory, member) is mixed iff its retained verdicts hold at least one success and one failure; cells = mixed member x 3 seeds (seed-free stages a/ap repeat the member's value in each seed cell, so member-clustered means are unchanged)
